meta.label: Vendor/Studio copy (older database GridSense_one.duckdb via studio/src/data-ext.js)
meta.cap_rule: Each governing case (summer_peak/injection, published as injection and as discharge; large_load/charge) keeps its own top 12 rows by pre-transfer loading plus every pre-existing row. The one non-governing case (summer_peak/charge, a data centre's second screen) keeps the rows the bus-wide top 12 selects plus every pre-existing row. n_rows is the full count on every key. A per-case cap on every key was measured at +5.9 MB and does not fit the file budget.
meta.cost_rule: elements with transfer_mw <= requested, excluding pre-existing (transfer_mw < 0), deduped by facility (Grid 3.17 rule)
